grc:pron:ἵ.inflection: ἵ, nom. of the reflex. Pron. οὗ

grc:other:Ι.gloss: The upper case letter iota, a letter resp. the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

grc:other:ι.gloss: Lower-case iota (ἰῶτα), the ninth letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the close front unrounded vowel /i/. It is preceded by θ and followed by κ.

grc:pron:ἱ.gloss: nominative singular of ῑ̔́, ῑ̔† (hī́, hī†)
